structural_review.private_rule: conjunct_conflict replaces coordinate-only linear_conflict; reuses polynomial division and existing relation evaluation
structural_review.applicability: Mandatory equalities only through AND; monomial/binomial nonconstant leading term, leading total degree >= tail total degree. Coordinate shortcut first. Up to one derived residue per original divisor; no recursive completion.
structural_review.arithmetic: Changed reductions reconstructed exactly as p=sum(q_i*d_i)+r; unchanged remainder uses p=p. Derived residues vanish wherever original equalities hold. All six mandatory relations evaluated only at constant residues.
structural_review.fallback: No Known(true) inference. No cancellation of zero factors, real root branch choice, OR/NOT assumptions, degree-raising substitutions or generic Groebner completion. Existing coefficient path/full CAD remain.
structural_review.formal: Existing Boolean Lean model byte-identical, selector generality reused; arithmetic identities and translation not formally proved.

benchmark_policy: 160 fixed ABBA trials, all completed within 3 seconds with exact decisions and result checks. Three intended UNSAT shortcut trees may change; all five controls retain identical non-timing output. All trials and block directions retained.
formal_scope: Boolean required-conjunct extraction and conditional conflict propagation only; polynomial division/reconstruction, QQ-to-real semantics and source translation are not formally proved. Existing full CAD and independent Z3 corpus remain.
cleanup: Own clean baseline worktree removed after comparison; frozen native artifacts, diagnostic profile and required raw records retained. Only main worktree remains.
